purpose: Low-token discovery index for released public Trigon records and public dataset candidates queued for possible future tests.
scan_rules: Preserve each released record's exact status and claim ceiling.
Treat dataset registry entries as candidates only; inclusion is not a validation claim or evidence for UBT.
Do not promote exploratory, failed, null, ambiguous, blocked, superseded, or candidate work.
Check related records, source IDs, dataset candidates, controls, failures, rights status, and version links before proposing a new test.
Deduplicate dataset candidates by canonical identifier, provider/version, and underlying data content before assigning a new stable ID.
Do not infer private, unpublished, restricted, or missing information.
Classify proposed work as reuse, reproduction, replication, extension, repair, or genuinely new only after the archive and candidate registry scan.
